paragraphs: Nappaḥa, R. Yitzḥak Nappaḥa's father. This requires examination, since Nappaḥa appears to be a town's name. R. Yehudah said: an incident concerning ben Nappaḥa, who had five courtyards in Usha, etc., HaDar 72b; see there.
